I'll start by exploring the workspace to find `main.go` and understand the existing code.Simple Go project. I'll add the helper to `main.go` and add a test for it, keeping `add` intact.Done. Implemented `countEven(nums []int) int` in `main.go`, which iterates the slice and counts values where `n%2 == 0` (also handles negatives and zero). The existing `add` function is unchanged.

Added a table-driven `TestCountEven` covering mixed, empty, all-even, all-odd, and negative cases. `go test ./...` passes.
